Definition: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of G1092; cultivable, i.e. a farm:--husbandry.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, geṓrgion means husbandry. It occurs just once, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I read geṓrgion plainly: husbandry, and I leave it there.
